asideReason: Indian ordinary passports need a Georgian visa. Australian passports do not. In April the high Caucasus is only partly open: Kazbegi is cold, and the roads into Tusheti and much of Svaneti are often still shut. It is a strong trip in May or June, and a compromised one for this group in April.
name: Georgia
summary: Three bases that still work in April: Tbilisi, the hill town of Sighnaghi in Kakheti, and one night toward Kazbek. Held back for the Indian visa and the shut high passes.
why: Tbilisi is the city. Sighnaghi is the easier landscape, low enough for April. Kazbegi is the one high night, and you come back down. The trip still does not reach the high villages of Tusheti or Svaneti.
distinctive: A capital in a river gorge, and Gergeti Trinity Church under Mount Kazbek when the last road is open.
weather: A Georgia monthly guide puts Tbilisi near 19°C by day and 8°C at night in April, with more rain than in March. Kazbegi is about 10°C by day and near freezing at night. Svaneti is colder and wetter. The Abano Pass into Tusheti is usually shut until late May or June.
crowds: April is not a peak month. Tbilisi is a city, not a resort crush. Kazbegi has a busy church car park on clear days.
natureExperiences: The Kazbegi valley and Gergeti, if the road to the church is open
A city gorge walk in Tbilisi
The Mtskheta cathedral town as a half day
Not Tusheti and not Ushguli in April
age6: Tbilisi's sulphur baths district from the street, a cable car, and a short stop below Gergeti. No high pass.
age12: The church and the mountain story, plus the food.
age14: The same, and the old town's layers. They will feel the limit of the April map.
adults: Food and wine. The wine is not the children's itinerary.
gettingAround: A driver is wiser than two rental cars in April on the Military Highway. Georgia drives on the right. Distances are short and roads are slow.
meetingPoint: Tbilisi. Connections from Bengaluru via Istanbul, the Gulf or Europe. Long from Melbourne.
visaAu: Georgia's official travel site lists Australia among the nationalities that do not need a visa and may stay up to a year. Recheck the same page. Rules of stay can still include registration details.
visaIn: The same official list does not give ordinary Indian passports a visa-free stay. Diplomatic or official Indian passports are a different case. Ordinary passports should plan on an e-visa through Georgia's official portal and should ignore copycat sites.
disadvantages: The April mountain map is Tbilisi plus Kazbegi, not the full Caucasus.
Indian ordinary passports need a visa. Australian passports do not.
A driver and winding roads for several days is a lot for age 6.
uncertainties: Whether the road to Gergeti Trinity is clear of ice in the week you go.
Svaneti access. Do not book Ushguli in April.

image.alt: Gergeti Trinity Church below a snowy peak in Kazbegi

gain: A less obvious capital and a real mountain church, with excellent food.
miss: The high valleys, a simple Indian visa, and mild mountain weather.

cost.summary: Bengaluru to Tbilisi is about ₹2.0–2.5 lakh for four adult typical returns. A Melbourne typical fare was not published. The Indian visa fee was not priced.

lines.text: Kayak.co.in’s typical return fare, Bengaluru to Tbilisi, was ₹50,666–₹63,438 for one adult, with one stop. Four adult fares are about ₹2.0–2.5 lakh. Not an April 2027 quote.
A typical Melbourne–Tbilisi return fare was not published in this pass.
Australian passports do not pay a visa fee for a short stay on the published list. Ordinary Indian passports need a visa. The fee was not read from the official e-visa table in this pass.

cost.leftOut: Hotels, meals, a driver and international flights are not included.

stretch16: Not the place to add days in April. Come in June if this is the dream.

days.optional: A cable car if energy remains
days.kids: The cable car is the first treat.
days.transfer: Airport to the old town is a taxi.

days.experience: Old town, a fortress view, and a free afternoon.
days.optional: The sulphur district from the street. Baths are optional and not for the children unless a family-friendly one is confirmed.
days.wet: A museum. Confirm which one is good for children before you rely on it.

days.experience: Drive east into Kakheti and stay in Sighnaghi.
days.optional: Walk the town wall once, then stop
days.highlight: A small hill town over a wine valley, low enough for April
days.kids: The wall and the view. One short walk.
days.transfer: About two hours from Tbilisi in normal conditions. Use a driver. Confirm the day you go.
days.seasonal: This valley is open when the high passes are not.
days.wet: The town is the plan. You do not need a vineyard.

days.experience: A slow valley morning. One short stop for the adults, then back to the town.
days.optional: A family-friendly cooking hour rather than a wine tour
days.highlight: Staying in the east instead of only seeing it from a bus
days.kids: The 6-year-old does not do a tasting room. Bread, cheese and a courtyard are the visit.
days.seasonal: April vines are not the autumn show. The town is the reason.

days.experience: Return toward Tbilisi and continue up the Military Highway with a driver. Stop at the fortress and the confluence viewpoints.
days.optional: Gergeti only if the final road is open and the weather is calm
days.kids: The drive is long and winding. Gergeti can be a short visit, not a hike.
days.transfer: Sighnaghi back through Tbilisi and on to Stepantsminda is a full day, often five hours or more. If that is too much, sleep in Tbilisi and drive up the next morning.
days.seasonal: Early April is the riskier half. A local driver is the recommendation in shoulder season.
days.wet: Do not climb to the church in cloud and ice. Stop in Tbilisi if the mountain road is bad.

days.experience: A slow mountain morning and the drive back to Tbilisi.
days.optional: A second look at Gergeti if yesterday failed
days.highlight: Snow on the peaks and green lower slopes
days.transfer: Back to Tbilisi the same day so you are not stuck if the weather turns.
days.seasonal: Have a Tbilisi hotel you can return to.

days.experience: Mtskheta half day, then a free afternoon.
days.highlight: An old church town at the rivers' meeting
days.kids: A half day is the right length.

days.highlight: A short trip, which is the honest April shape
days.seasonal: If you wanted two weeks, this destination is telling you to come later in the year.
